summary: Every check a sender makes before it sends a message now asks the graph, the messages shard and the message outbox, so a send retried down the other store's path replays the message its first send wrote instead of writing a second (db break-up step 4c-2a-3). An offline backup export refuses a database copy whose message outbox still holds mail and names the waiting messages. Members advertise messages_stream_inbox=1, the complete stream inbox later releases route mail on. Nothing in the product writes stream mail yet, so no user sees a change until a later release routes mail to the stream.

replay.detail: No claim is written, admitted or projected differently. A graph message.sent append whose idempotency key or subject the messages shard already holds returns the stream item (appended=false) instead of writing a graph claim, and a stream append whose key or subject the graph holds returns the graph claim; in this build only tests and a peer's replicated items put messages in the shard, so neither case arises in use.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or user_version change. The new checks read existing tables by their primary key or index: the graph's operations and claims_subject_kind_index, the graph file's local_stream_sent and local_message_outbox, and the shard's stream_operations and stream_messages.

rules.detail: Idempotency now spans both stores. A message.sent under an idempotency key that either store already holds replays that store's claim for the same request and is refused with idempotency-mismatch for another, whichever path the retry takes; a message.sent without a key replays a message the other store holds under its subject. A lock in the daemon, striped by subject and key, holds each path's check and write together, so two concurrent sends of one message write it once. Store::operation_claim (behind GET /v1/messages/by-key and the work wake route) finds a key a stream send used.

compatibility.detail: Additive. The daemon.started feature messages_stream_inbox=1 says a member lists, counts and dedupes stream mail as it does graph mail; no member routes on it in this build (4c-2b will, and messages_shard::inbox_hosts reads it, current start only, as advertising_hosts reads messages_stream). A release without it (v0.3.28 and earlier) never advertises it, and a member upgraded in place advertises it at its next start and stops when it rolls back. Members of the previous release see no new kind and no copy of any message.

manual.detail: An offline export (`fractal backup create FILE --database COPY`) of a copy whose message outbox holds mail now fails with `offline export refuses a copy whose message outbox holds N message(s) not yet in its messages shard (...)`: start the member's daemon so it writes them, then copy the database again. In this build nothing queues messages, so the outbox is always empty and no export refuses.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to a release without these checks returns to graph-only checks, which is what that release always did; the stores' contents are unchanged. Archives and restore are unchanged, apart from the offline export's refusal above.
